propositions: Pytest default-long traceback renders fixture arguments through 240-character saferepr, causing ambient credentials in the box fixture's returned os.environ mapping to be printed verbatim in failure output.

The fixture boundary must pass only required environment variables (PATH, DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX, HEALTH_TIMEOUT) rather than copying the full ordered os.environ to prevent credential leakage in pytest function argument rendering.
Seven sibling subprocess fixtures in autodeploy and observability test files use the same dict(os.environ)-inside-rendered-fixture pattern and require equivalent repairs or linked follow-ups.
Synthetic sentinel probes confirm the pytest fixture argument rendering (not subprocess logging or autodeploy behavior) is the carrier of the leaked credentials.
